mentions.name: Old-school FOSS forum in Rust
mentions.description: An old-school, open-source forum platform written in Rust with a SQLite backend and modern UI niceties, modeled on phpBB. It is designed to run in resource-constrained environments with minimal setup, targeting deployment on single-board computers or Unikraft, and using cloudflared to expose the hosted service to others.
mentions.problem: Long-running forums are being bought up by VerticalScope, replacing small self-hosted communities that existed for the love of it with monetized interaction.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm going whole hog on LLM-driven development to build out an old school FOSS forum that can run in resource-constrained environments with a minimum of fuss. Think phpBB but written in Rust with modern UI niceties and a SQLite backend.
mentions.author: alexjplant
